article.headline: O'Neal nets 23, Sivka adds 17, No. 12 Kentucky women defeat Marshall 85-49
article.description: — Me'Arah O'Neal scored 16 of her 23 points in the second half, Ajsa Sivka had 15 of her 17 in the first half and No. 12 Kentucky rolled to an 85-49 win over Marshall on Friday night.

article.story: LEXINGTON, Ky. -- — Me'Arah O'Neal scored 16 of her 23 points in the second half, Ajsa Sivka had 15 of her 17 in the first half and No. 12 Kentucky rolled to an 85-49 win over Marshall on Friday night. Reserve Emily McDonald hit four 3s and scored 12 points for the Wildcats (6-0). Clara Strack added 10 points and matched O'Neal, who had four blocks, with nine rebounds. Cassie Gallagher had 15 points for the Thundering Herd (5-2). Sivka hit all three of her 3s in the first half as the Wildcats raced to a 44-20 lead. Marshall led 3-2 but Kentucky scored the next seven and led 20-11 after one quarter. The Wildcats, with Sivka hit two 3s and a pair of free throws, closed the half on a 13-0 run. O'Neal had eight points in a 15-0 run in the third quarter that stretched the lead to 61-25. O'Neal was 6-of-8 shooting with four free throws in the second half. Kentucky won the turnover battle 16-9, outscoring the Thundering Herd 22-0 after miscues. Up next Marshall: Home against Davis & Elkins on Tuesday. Kentucky: Home against Maine next Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
